name: BreedingCalvingManager
tagline: Heats, services, PD, calving and fertility KPIs in one drop-in Power Platform app.
description: A complete breeding module for dairy herds, suckler herds and sheep or goat flocks: record heats and AI or natural services with sire and technician, enter pregnancy-diagnosis results from scan sessions, follow every pregnancy to the expected calving or lambing date and record births with ease, offspring and weights. Fertility KPIs – conception rate, services per conception, days open and calving interval – update live.
features: Heat → Served → Pregnant → Calved pipeline with Empty, Lost and undo
Gestation per species, heat-return watch, earliest PD and dry-off dates
Scan session bulk PD with rule-based skips
Conception rate by sire, service number and technician
Dam lookup and dam history with calving intervals
Demo mode, phone bottom bar, keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (two controls: BreedingCalvingManager data-set + BreedingCalvingManagerPortal field control, shared src/app)
